summary: Retested the broadened Mark Complete render condition on Contracts.jsx (L1827 & L2065) for multi-role rating prompt UI integration. End-to-end flow now works with NO Mongo tinkering: (1) demo user creates a multi-join LFG (join_mode='multi', status stays 'open' after /accept), (2) admin joins via POST /api/contracts/{id}/accept, (3) demo poster's My Contracts card renders the Mark Complete button, (4) clicking it opens data-testid='multi-rating-modal' with one row per accepted participant (Mowri row visible), (5) selecting 5 stars and clicking submit calls POST /api/contracts/{id}/rate-participant, row shows '✓ Rated', and server-side contract.participant_ratings now contains {rating:5, rated_user_id, rated_handle:'Mowri'}, (6) the multi-rating-done button (labelled DONE once all rows are submitted, FINISH LATER otherwise) closes the modal. Non-poster regression also confirmed: admin (participant, not poster) does NOT see Mark Complete on demo's multi-join open contract in his My Contracts list — the card renders as 'COMBAT OPEN (ACCEPTED)' without any MC/Copy Handle buttons. Single-bid single-review regression verified by code inspection: _openMultiRatingIfNeeded early-returns false when join_mode!='multi' && !is_multi_crew (Contracts.jsx L527-528), so handleMarkComplete falls through to setShowReview({...role:'both'}) — the pre-existing single-review flow (unchanged). Multi-crew post-/deploy path was fully verified in iteration_18 and its render condition (contract.is_multi_crew branch of the OR) is unchanged relative to that verified path.

issues: Onboarding carousel cannot be dismissed by clicking the top-right X (data-testid missing on close button); Escape key does not close it either. Only 'Next' → 'Get Started' walks through and dismisses. Not blocking for functionality but worth adding data-testid='onboarding-close' + Escape handling for tests and a11y.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and correct: the OR clause added at Contracts.jsx L1827 and L2065 gates on poster_id == user.id AND (join_mode=='multi' || is_multi_crew) AND (has accepted_participants OR any manifest slot with accepted_by.id) AND status not in [completed, cancelled, expired]. This preserves single-bid behavior because _openMultiRatingIfNeeded early-returns for non-multi contracts.

Note: POST /api/contracts/{id}/mark-complete (server.py:4321) does NOT accept status='open' — it returns {'message':'Invalid contract state'} with 200. The frontend still opens the multi-rating modal because axios doesn't throw and _openMultiRatingIfNeeded runs unconditionally after the response. This works for the rating flow but the underlying contract remains status='open' server-side even after 'Mark Complete' is clicked and ratings are recorded. Consider extending mark_contract_complete to accept status='open' when join_mode='multi' with participants (auto-complete or transition to a 'completed' terminal state), otherwise poster can keep re-opening the rating modal indefinitely and the contract never moves off the Job Board.
server.py still 5092 lines — carry-over from prior review, split into routers when convenient.
The 'Cancel' button appears to render twice per card in some layouts (visible in screenshot as two CANCEL buttons side by side) — pre-existing, not caused by this fix, but worth de-duplicating.

If product wants the contract to actually complete for multi-join LFGs, main agent should extend server.py:4338 to accept join_mode='multi' && status='open' with accepted_participants and transition it to 'completed'.
rca of the issue: N/A — fix verified. Root cause of the previously reported gap (iter_18): Mark Complete render condition only allowed status ∈ {in_progress, pending_completion, active}, but multi-join LFGs stay 'open' after /accept. The fix adds an OR branch permitting poster-of-multi-with-participants regardless of 'open' status, unblocking the multi-rating modal path for multi-join LFGs without any DB tampering.
